about: plugin-frame.1 validator vectors (Phase 10; docs/INTEGRATIONS.md, "Contract `plugin-frame.1`"). `host`: messages a Workspace page sends (init on the window, the rest on the port), run through parseHostMessage; `plugin`: messages a plugin sends, through parsePluginMessage; `valid` is the verdict. `props`: what a setProps carries, through checkProps: `ok` with `kept` (what is written: top-level keys starting with "$" dropped) or the refused code. `manifest`: manifest.json through parseManifest, with the errors the server lists. `bundlePaths` and `bundleTypes`: a bundle's file names and the types files are served as. An object whose "$vector" key names a value JSON cannot hold stands for it: "undefined"; "number" (value "NaN", "Infinity" or "-Infinity"); "date" (a Date); "map" (a Map of a to 1); "bytes" (a Uint8Array of 1, 2, 3); "sparse" (an array of `length` with only its last index set, to 0); "text" (`repeat` repeated `count` times); "list" (`count` copies of `item`, each with "{{i}}" in its strings replaced by its index); "nest" (`leaf` inside `depth` arrays). Keys such as "__proto__" are own properties (as JSON.parse and a structured clone make them): decode with defineProperty, never assignment.
